title: Concept: Locked graph mixes a local project into a package restore
description: packages.lock.json declares a locked dependency that resolves to a project reference, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a locked dependency that resolves to a project reference.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.lock.json (nuget).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a locked dependency that resolves to a project reference.
